tei:div.tei:p: 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs char 'bebs bzhugs so//1$0000210 e ma ho/ gdod ma'i mgon po chos sku 'od mtha' yas// nges pa lnga ldan longs sku spyan ras gzigs// gang 'dul der ston sprul sku pad+ma 'byung*// gsol ba 'debs so byin rlabs char chen phobs// pad+ma'i thugs sras sna nam bdud 'joms rje// zab chos bka' bab rig rtsal thogs med zhabs// bka' drin gsum ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so byin rlabs char chen phobs// rab 'byams zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor yi dam lha// gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig can// ye shes las grub chos skyong srung mar bcas// gsol ba 'debs so byin rlabs char chen phobs// tshad med bzhi ldan byang chub sems mchog 'byongs// smin byed dbang gi rdo rje bzhi 'bras smin// grol byed khrid kyis gnas lugs mngon gyur te// 'phags mchog snying rje'i gter chen 'grub par shog /1$0000210ces pa'ang 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs yang zab bcud kyi thig le'i cha rkyen du kun bzang nges don bshad sgrub mthar phyin pas gang shar gsol ba btab pa dge1$0000210 /bzhad pa rdo rje'i thugs kyi sgyu 'phrul du// mchog gzigs dam pa'i lung gis dbang bskul zhing*// zab mo'i don la mos pa lhur len pa// ye shes rang grol zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// 'di bzung skye dang skye ba thams cad du// mgon po khyed dang nam yang mi 'bral zhing*// smin grol gdams pa'i bdud rtsi'i bcud bzang pos// yongs su smin nas don gnyis
